paraphrase: Twelve positions — beginning with the view that all is to be known by practice alone and running through determinism, nature, time, Īśvara, the self, Sāṃkhya, Vaiśeṣika, Buddhist and grammarian views — are arranged as spokes of a wheel, each overturned by the next; the Jain view is the whole wheel, in which each is valid in its place.
notes: The sequence of the twelve spokes is given from memory and is uncertain.
